tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search deali.co.il's curated catalog of AliExpress deals for Israeli shoppers. Returns matching products with prices in ILS (₪), discount %, rating, a buy link (deali.co.il affiliate link), and a coupon code when the seller has one that works now. Titles and descriptions are in Hebrew — Hebrew queri

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: AliExpress promo codes that work right now for shoppers in Israel: the site-wide codes of the current sale (code, discount, minimum order, valid-until date) and seller codes for specific products (code, discount and minimum spend in ILS, expiry, price with the code). Each entry has a link to shop wi

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch full details for one product by its deali id (e.g. "ali_1005001234567890"): title, Hebrew description, prices in ILS, discount, rating, review/sold counts, image, and buy link.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List deali.co.il's Hebrew blog posts — AliExpress buying guides, product roundups, and shopping tips for Israelis. Returns id, title, excerpt, category, and publish date.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Fetch one blog post by id, including its full HTML content (Hebrew).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_deals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
